C0779.title: Lanzhou University Server Compromised by Remote Cryptomining Malware with Lateral Spread
C0779.summary: In May 2026, a university in Lanzhou discovered that its server had been remotely implanted with cryptomining malware, which then spread laterally to other office devices. Local cyber police conducted a source-tracing investigation into the hacker attack, and the public security authorities imposed an administrative penalty on the university for failing to fulfill its cybersecurity protection obli
